channels.profile_prior: independent persistent copy with rho, invert otherwise
channels.signals: four independent conditional channels, accuracy q

genome.decode: c_s=sigmoid(logit(rho)+b/4+(match?u/4:-d/4)); rho endpoints exact; score=sum_s (2q-1)(2c_s-1)(2report_s-1); intervene iff score>k/8

operators.crossover: each gene independently from either parent with probability 1/2
operators.elites: 2 unchanged; count every candidate including repeats
operators.fitness: complete exact world enumeration; training only
operators.mutation: each gene independently probability 1/4, equal +/-1, clamp
operators.ranking: exact payoff descending; integer L1 ascending; gene tuple lexicographic ascending; stable exact ties
